preconditions: the existing transaction authority database and its released schema version 2 are preserved unchanged
the new journal is empty or already has authenticated LNRQ schema version 1 and the exact canonical schema fingerprint
the composition root provides a protected directory and an independently provisioned non-zero integrity key that is retained across restarts
